digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume surface and gate format
propositions: Remote gate blob maintains dual-format encoding with gated_mode:reconcile-check alongside paused/reason/who/paused_at to preserve old readers while supporting new pause/resume surface
Pause operation returns rc 0 with exact anchored JSON BRIDGE_PAUSED marker before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, enabling workflow to recognize and skip commit-and-push on pause
Resume operation performs observed-OID CAS delete and safely recovers from corrupt blob state without decoding or traceback
Pre-gate reconcile-check early return and legacy rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary remain functional for backward compatibility

Pause metadata enforces repository git user.email identity and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp with idempotent same-reason re-pause and conflict refusal on different-reason/blank/missing-identity/missing-remote/CAS-movement cases
